title: W1 CLOCK AUTHORITY CONTRACT

implementationResponsibilities.capture: producer / initial prospective allocator implementation location

directionEvidence.standing: approves finalisation direction, NOT this exact publication

statusRule: Controlled specification on competent Owner-authorised verified publication; candidate before that event
effectivityRule: Effective for W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE at the verified Owner-authorised atomic publication revision; no invented date or containing hash
operationalApplicability: NOT established by publication; exact real format, issuer/allocator, principal/grant, policy and deployment applicability required before corresponding real use
implementationAuthorisation: NONE conveyed by this specification or its publication
proposedCompatibilityClass: NEW VERSIONED BOUNDARY; not an in-place reinterpretation of ClockSnapshot v1
producer: Capture official clock, only under verified bound subject and scoped eligible authority
consumer: Tagger qualified read-only observer; not a producer or transformer
transformer: none in first slice; any future transformation needs independent applicable role/use evidence
direction: new producer to new observer only; old v1 remains separate legacy-qualified boundary
proposedTechnicalLimits: Protocol identifiers/reference strings: 1–512 Unicode characters; unsigned decimal ordering strings: 1–64 digits; seconds: non-negative signed-int32 range; UUIDv4: fixed profile; SHA-256: 64 lower-case hex; Ed25519 signature: 88 base64 characters. Refuse overflow/unsupported limits; never truncate or change an issued local ID. These are candidate wire limits, not approved service SLOs.
schemaVersusSemantic: Wire structure necessary, not sufficient; verification rules and material history remain independently required
signedPayload: UTF-8 compact JSON with recursively UTF-16-sorted object keys, array order preserved, excluding attestation; integer-only numeric protocol values; reject invalid Unicode scalar strings; SHA-256 then Ed25519 over lowercase ASCII digest
trust: Separately competent grant decisions, applicable scope-complete control-plane coverage and exact local trust bundle required. Fixtures are non-operational; no real principal appointment.
history: ordering within subject/principal/binding/incarnation only; same tuple and same bytes => replay, same tuple different bytes => conflict; authorised correction has later same-context sequence and attributable prior/new activity
gapConflict: reason explicit; identifiers/order may be null; clock state withheld; no authoritative progress; no false authoritative pause; last trusted observation can remain labelled historical
unsupported: reject invalid structure/subject/signature; quarantine unavailable/mismatched context; withhold unverified authority; no fallback to latest or legacy-as-governed
projection: none in first-slice Tagger observer; no advance inferred from transport freshness
testAndActivation: Frozen vectors demonstrate development candidate rules only; product role/use/runtime conformance and real operational appointment/format/policy/deployment remain separate gates.
applicability: W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE upon verified approved publication. Generic product work still requires separate W1-1 authorisation. Real application requires exact external operational context.

capabilityModel.envelope: authority.capability is snapshot or null. It attests permission to emit the observation, NOT permission for every state-producing operation.
capabilityModel.state: Applicable grant/activity/baseline evidence must independently establish the requested transition's capability. Running progression requires advance; corrections require correct and retained prior/new history; recovery requires recover and new eligibility/incarnation.
capabilityModel.consumer: Read-only consumer never acts on emission permission as progress/correction/transfer authority. Absent proofs => withheld or historical-qualified observation, never authoritative progression.

canonicalBytes.input: Parse JSON with duplicate object names rejected. All strings must contain valid Unicode scalars; reject lone surrogates. No Unicode normalization.
canonicalBytes.objectKeys: Recursively ascending unsigned UTF-16 code-unit lexicographic order, ordinal and locale-independent; duplicate decoded keys rejected.
canonicalBytes.strings: Quote with U+0022. Escape quote/backslash and U+0008/0009/000A/000C/000D as \", \\, \b, \t, \n, \f, \r. Other U+0000..001F as lower-case \u00xx. All other Unicode scalars are emitted as UTF-8 unescaped, including slash, U+2028/U+2029 and supplementary characters.
canonicalBytes.numbers: Finite non-negative integers in 0..2147483647 only; negative zero refused. Equivalent allowed JSON numeric spellings are canonicalized to plain unsigned base-10 without leading zeros, decimal point or exponent. Ordering counters are strings and remain byte-preserved.
canonicalBytes.whitespace: None; no BOM or trailing newline
canonicalBytes.attestationExclusion: Remove ONLY the top-level attestation member from a clock envelope before canonicalizing. All remaining fields included. Governance bundle excludes only its top-level governanceProof for its proof calculation.
canonicalBytes.sha256: Hash exact canonical UTF-8 bytes; encode digest as 64 lower-case ASCII hexadecimal characters.
canonicalBytes.exactSignedBytes: Ed25519 signs exactly the 64 ASCII bytes of the lower-case SHA-256 hexadecimal digest; NOT the raw payload, NOT the 32 binary digest bytes, NOT a prehashed Ed25519ph message.
canonicalBytes.keyId: Exact opaque reference resolved only within the pinned applicable trust bundle, paired with algorithm, principal and grant scope. Never global text equality, self-appointment or current/default key selection.
canonicalBytes.failure: Invalid Unicode/duplicate names/numbers/algorithm/key/context/signature => reject; missing applicable grant/coverage/effectivity => withhold; valid signature alone grants nothing.
